cases.question: ¿Cuánto se egresó por caja registradora en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cm.amount) AS egresos FROM cash_movement cm JOIN cash_session cs ON cs.id = cm.session_id JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cm.type = 'EXPENSE' AND cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY egresos DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja_registradora, COALESCE(SUM(cm.amount), 0) AS total_egresado FROM public.cash_movement AS cm JOIN public.cash_session AS cs ON cm.session_id = cs.id JOIN public.cash_register AS cr ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE cm.type = 'EXPENSE' AND cm.created_at >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND cm.created_at < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cr.name LIMIT 50
